solution_title: Fleet Telematics, Road-Snapped GPS & Dispatch Dashboard
summary: A cohesive Dallas fleet telematics, road-snapping, and multi-stop dispatch dashboard built strictly on modern zero-deprecation Google Maps Platform APIs. On load, it initializes a distraction-free vector map (mapId with clickableIcons disabled and optional TrafficLayer), discovers real Dallas logistics hubs via Places API (New), renders status-coded fleet vehicles (En Route, Delayed, Idle) using AdvancedMarkerElement, snaps noisy raw vehicle GPS breadcrumbs to Dallas road corridors via Roads API (snapToRoads), and computes multi-stop dispatch polylines and hub-to-stop ETA/distance matrices via Routes API (Route.computeRoutes / RouteMatrix.computeRouteMatrix on pure client stacks; BFF REST proxies with explicit X-Goog-FieldMask on Next.js, FastAPI, and Node.js Express).
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (Vector Map, AdvancedMarkerElement, PinElement, InfoWindow, Polyline, TrafficLayer)
seed_search_query: distribution center logistics hub Dallas TX
ui_layout_summary: Full-viewport split-screen dispatch console: (1) Compact top command bar (56px) with app title, live fleet status counts, status filter pills (All, En Route, Delayed, Idle), traffic overlay toggle, and a PlaceAutocompleteElement hub search box; (2) Left telemetry & dispatch sidebar (400px desktop width, responsive drawer/stack on mobile) featuring three synchronized sections: Active Fleet Telemetry Cards (speed, next stop, live ETA, status badge), GPS Trace & Roads API Inspector (raw vs. road-snapped polyline toggle, point counts, road segment count, mean snap offset), and Multi-Stop Dispatch & Route Matrix Panel (depot, stop sequence, optimize-order toggle, Compute Dispatch button, and hub-to-stop ETA/distance table); (3) Right primary interactive map canvas (flex-1, min-height: 520px, height: calc(100vh - 56px)) displaying status-coded vehicle AdvancedMarkerElements, numbered depot/hub markers, dashed raw GPS trace vs. solid road-snapped polyline, multi-stop corridor polyline, and an interactive legend + vehicle InfoWindow.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for calculating multi-stop dispatch corridor routes, leg ETAs, optional waypoint order optimization, and encoded polylines between the Dallas central depot and drop-off hubs.
Server-side BFF proxy for computing travel-time and distance matrices from the central depot (and active vehicles) to all selected Dallas drop-off hubs.

Server-side BFF proxy forwarding noisy raw GPS breadcrumb coordinates to Roads API Snap to Roads (with interpolate=true and X-Goog-Maps-Solution-ID: gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0) to return road-snapped path coordinates and road segment Place IDs.
Server-side BFF proxy for executing live Places API (New) text searches on load to discover real Dallas logistics hubs and drop-off facilities without client-side CORS exposure.
